ios.desc:
Wake AI is a talking alarm clock for iPhone that wakes you with a personal spoken message instead of a generic alarm sound. Use it for calmer mornings, motivation, routines, meetings, workouts, or any moment where hearing the reason matters more than another ringtone.

Create alarms that speak to you:

• Write a custom message for each alarm
• Choose from built-in voices or create your own custom voice
• Personalize how your alarm starts with voice-only, gentle wake, or bell modes
• Add snooze controls and choose your snooze duration
• Create alarms with Siri using your default settings
• See a Live Activity countdown while snoozing
• Preview alarm styles before saving
• Set repeating alarms for daily routines, meetings, workouts, and morning plans

WHY PEOPLE USE WAKE AI

A normal alarm tells you it is time. Wake AI can tell you why.

Start the day with a message like:

• “Good morning. Time for your workout.”
• “Wake up slowly. You have your first meeting at 8.”
• “Take a breath, get up, and start the routine.”
• “Remember why today matters.”

Wake AI works well for personal encouragement, spoken task cues, custom morning prompts, and practical alarms that explain what you need to do next.

RELIABLE IPHONE ALARMS

Wake AI uses Apple AlarmKit, Apple's native iPhone alarm framework. Alarms are designed to behave like system alarms, including sounding even when the app is closed and following iOS alarm behavior for Focus modes such as Do Not Disturb.

USE WAKE AI FOR

• Talking alarm clock wake-ups
• Custom voice alarm messages
• Morning motivation
• Gentle wake-up routines
• Snooze-friendly alarms
• Siri-created alarms
• Meeting, workout, and habit cues
• Personal affirmations without a separate affirmation app

TRY WAKE AI FREE

Wake AI can be downloaded and used free. Creating new personalized alarm messages requires an active subscription. Check the app for current plans and prices.

Wake up to a message that actually helps you get moving.

quotes.text:
Hi Show HN,

I’m really excited to share something I’ve been working on since late November last year.

I’ve always struggled to wake up in the morning. I’d often feel groggy when my alarm first went off, turn it off, and drift back to sleep. Then I tried something different. I recorded myself saying a message about why I should get up, edited it in GarageBand, and turned it into a ringtone for my Apple Clock alarm. It worked. Hearing my own voice remind me of what I needed to accomplish made it much easier to wake up.

But there was a problem. Updating the alarm every day was tedious. I had to record a new voice memo, edit it in GarageBand, export it, and set it as my ringtone. And after a while, I got tired of my own voice. It’s kind of weird hearing yourself first thing in the morning . Around that time, I also started playing around with ElevenLabs voice technology and realized this app would be perfect to put their incredibly realistic voices to use. So I decided to build an app to make this process effortless.

The app is called Wake AI and it is available on iOS and iPadOS. It lets you create talking voice alarms with custom messages. You can choose from a wide range of natural AI voices, making it feel like someone is actually talking to you in the morning. I find it extremely useful because I can change the voice every night based on my mood. Some days I like a Western cowboy to wake me up. Some days, if I feel unmotivated, I choose a sports coach voice. Other days, …

quotes.title: I built a tool to wake my ass up every morning
